title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
slides: DeepSeek just raised $15B — does that even add up?
The round reportedly closed days after US restrictions
The money may be funding compute it can no longer buy
Your API costs could shift as DeepSeek reroutes supply
Watch the next earnings report before trusting the hype
thread_text:
1. $15B days after US curbs

DeepSeek reportedly closed a $15B round just days after new US export restrictions hit. The timing is the story — not the number.

2. Money vs. machines

The cash may be funding compute DeepSeek can no longer actually buy. Capital raised, hardware blocked — that gap has to close somewhere.

3. Your API bill is the tell

As DeepSeek reroutes its supply chain, your API costs could shift. Watch pricing changes as the first public signal of the squeeze.

4. Earnings will expose the gap

The next earnings report is where the rerouting shows up in real numbers. Hype fades; line items don't.

5. Check your own API spend today

Pull your last invoice and compare it to this month's usage. If the delta surprises you, you already know where to look next.
